author: LordofCorn
body:
It appears that I have been banned for fly hacking on one of your Nebula servers. I have to admit that I was indeed hacking at the time, it was a foolish mistake that I had made. I never truly realised how much I enjoyed this server and how hacking is so painful to other players. I honestly believe that anyone that hacks is a complete idiot (this includes myself)  for not taking a game for granted and constantly exploiting it. I am sorry and I hope that I will be allowed back onto the Avicus network soon. I will never hack again on any server.

-DarkLord_Xenon
-LordofCorn
